description: Return the dsh-plugin-certification specification document, version 1: the five graded dimensions, the grade scale from A to F, and the veto rule that can override a grade. Use this to interpret a grade you have already read - for example to learn why a record was vetoed, or what a dimension actually measures. Use list_certified or get_certification instead when you want a specific plugin's data rather than the rules behind it. Read-only: the document is compiled into the server, takes no parameters, performs no writes and needs no credentials. The same document is returned on every call.
name: certification_spec
title: Explain the certification spec
